title: Incident communications playbook and action-closure log for EU capacity regression
creator: Maya Chen
description: Summary: On 2026-02-27 we observed elevated error rates and token-level latency spikes affecting ~12% of EU-hosted requests. Root cause analysis shows a regression in the KV cache garbage collection during a model-variant rollout which caused memory pressure on several dedicated pools and degraded the serving runtime's scheduler. Some tenants experienced timeouts and automatic fallbacks to lower-capacity variants resulted in inconsistent outputs. This ticket tracks customer-facing communications, status page updates, the finalized RCA narrative, and a consolidated action-closure log to ensure transparent follow-ups and mitigations are completed before the public postmortem is published.

2026-02-27 02:22 UTC - Pager duty triggered; oncall engaged; initial mitigation: scaled dedicated pool + enabled emergency eviction window
2026-02-27 02:40 UTC - Temporary routing rule applied to divert new requests to alternative model variants for affected customers
2026-02-27 03:05 UTC - Rollback of the model-variant rollout completed; error rate returned to baseline by 03:28 UTC
2026-02-27 05:10 UTC - First customer advisory sent to affected tenants (narrow scope, technical summary)
2026-03-01 10:00 UTC - Internal RCA draft completed by applied-ml and infra teams

2026-03-09 09:15 UTC - Final action owners assigned; this ticket opened to centralize closure tracking
action_items: A1: Implement conservative KV cache GC thresholds and add a reactive scaling knob (owner: Priya Kapoor, due: 2026-03-12)
A2: Add a deterministic canary for model-variant rollouts that measures cache residency and memory delta before full rollout (owner: Tomas Rivera, due: 2026-03-20)
A3: Create a customer-friendly incident summary (2-paragraph), one-page FAQ, and tailored emails for top 10 affected tenants (owner: Elena Petrova, due: 2026-03-11)
A4: Post public statuspage update with timeline and 'what we're doing' section; coordinate publish window with legal/PR (owner: Liam O'Connor, due: 2026-03-10)
A5: Add automated alerts for early signs of KV GC regressions (owner: Devops Team, due: 2026-03-08)
A6: Run chaos/recovery runbook exercise simulating KV pressure across dedicated pools and document SLO impact (owner: Reliability Eng, due: 2026-03-25)
A7: Update runbook for fallback behavior to ensure deterministic outputs when falling back to alternate model variants (owner: Runtime Eng, due: 2026-03-18)
A8: Customer credits review and decision for impacted tenants (owner: Customer Success, due: 2026-03-17)
A9: Finalize and publish postmortem blog with technical appendix and mitigation roadmap (owner: Ops Docs, due: 2026-03-22)
